principle: The component owns the composition. Atlas editorial work chooses the two strongest activity-specific chapter angles and one complementary field note from verified information. The slots are never predefined as route, price, timing, history or any other topic.

presentation.layout: two chapters on the left, one secondary Field Card photo on the right, one fixed-position post-it note

chapters.selectionRule: Choose two distinct angles that deserve explanation for this specific activity. Lead with what is most useful, distinctive or consequential in the verified material.
chapters.antiPattern: Do not fill chapter one with route or chapter two with price by habit. If access is trivial, admission is free, or another subject matters more, choose different angles.

note.selectionRule: Use one concise field note that complements rather than repeats the chapters. It may cover route, price, clothing, timing, etiquette, weather, safety, equipment or another useful detail.

generationInput.subsequentSections: When fieldCardPrimaryStory is supplied, candidate.sections contains only later Field Card chapters.
